## 1. Executive Summary
ReachX is a premier growth agency and performance marketing consultancy engineered to scale modern direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, B2B enterprises, and franchise networks. Unlike traditional agencies that focus on vanity metrics, ReachX builds quantifiable client acquisition pipelines grounded in data engineering, real-time attribution, and high-converting creative psychology.

## 2. Core Service Capabilities

### A. Meta Ads Specialization (Facebook & Instagram Advertising)
- Multi-tier campaign architecture: Cold Prospecting (TOF), Consideration & Engagement (MOF), and Dynamic Retargeting & Direct Purchase (BOF).
- Server-side Meta Conversion API (CAPI) infrastructure: Eliminating signal loss from iOS 14.5+ and privacy tracking barriers with 98%+ Event Match Quality.
- Dynamic Creative Testing (DCT) frameworks systematically testing visual hooks, angles, pain points, and offer structures.
- Lead Qualification Architectures: Integrating native instant forms with interactive conditional logic to filter tire-kickers before CRM delivery.

### B. Social Media Marketing Agency (SMMA) Systems
- End-to-end client acquisition for local businesses, real estate, education, healthcare, and retail brands searching for top-tier SMMA representation.
- Hyper-local targeting utilizing geographic radius fencing, postal code targeting, and demographic enrichment.
- Omni-channel synergy across Meta, Google Search, YouTube, and LinkedIn.

### C. Franchise Expansion & Multi-Location Scaling
- Scaled over 140+ franchised outlets across India for brands including MahaChai and Pyramid.
- Geo-targeted investor generation funnels qualifying net-worth, location readiness, and capital commitment.

### D. Modern Web Architecture & CRO
- Editorial-grade Next.js, React, and headless web development.
- Ultra-fast load times, responsive interactive lightboxes, and psychological friction removal.
